title: Source registry
description: content/sources.json: every creator, outlet, wiki, map project and account we cite or credit. Articles are keyed by outlet; the author stays on the find's source entry.

url.description: Null when the research did not record a URL, or when the source must not be linked.

status.description: caution: a lead only, never the sole source. blocked: never cite, link or embed (piracy, leaks).
